title: Inquest into Fatal Hyperinsulinemic Hypoglycemia of Smt. Sharda Devi
citation: Independent Contributor: Dr. Shweta Rastogi (NFSU) & Prof. K. Sharma (NFSU Gandhinagar)
confidence_note: High - Confirmation bias trap: Stepson Rahul had heated will dispute 4 hours prior and inherits ?8 Crore, but post-mortem C-peptide assay and medicine lock prove 04:15 AM injection by nurse on duty.

ground_truth.culprit_summary: Night Ward Nurse Sunita (Fatal Exogenous Insulin Overdose)
ground_truth.rationale: Biochemical toxicology proves profound hypoglycemia with serum insulin > 1000 pmol/L and zero detectable C-peptide (< 0.1 ng/mL), establishing injection of synthetic exogenous human insulin. Automated medicine refrigerator dispensing logs confirm Sunita unlocked the rapid-acting insulin cartridge at 04:11 AM, while stepson Rahul departed the hospital at 01:30 AM.

hypotheses.label: Spontaneous Endogenous Insulinoma Crisis
hypotheses.statement: The patient experienced acute neuroglycopenic coma caused by an undetected neuroendocrine pancreatic islet tumor.

exhibits.name: Clinical Biochemistry Toxicological Assay (C-Peptide vs Free Insulin)
exhibits.text: Post-admission serum assay confirms circulating free insulin level was extremely elevated at 1,240 pmol/L with completely suppressed C-peptide concentration of < 0.05 ng/mL. In endogenous insulinoma, C-peptide is elevated equimolarly with insulin; zero C-peptide is the definitive scientific hallmark of exogenous synthetic insulin administration, entirely ruling out spontaneous pancreatic tumor.

exhibits.name: Hospital Main Entrance Turnstile & Uber Ride Telemetry (Stepson Alibi)
exhibits.text: Hospital visitor gate RFID card logs, lobby CCTV, and verified Uber trip receipts establish Stepson Rahul exited the hospital premises at 01:28 AM and was dropped at his residence in Bandra West at 02:04 AM. The patient's continuous glycemic monitor records normal blood glucose until 04:12 AM, when an abrupt precipitous crash occurred, conclusively eliminating Rahul as the administrator.

exhibits.name: Ward High-Risk Medication Refrigerator Smart-Lock Audit
exhibits.text: Smart-lock biometric access audit of the intensive care medication refrigerator proves Nurse Sunita scanned her credentials at 04:11:15 AM and withdrew a 100 IU vial of Humalog insulin without corresponding physician prescription entry on the electronic health record.
